integrity: The proof uses the source's shortest-embedding length and rank characterization, then applies rank-nullity and generalized-support definitions. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks small systematic binary and ternary codes, source-normal-form shortest embeddings, kernel subcodes, and every generalized Hamming weight involved.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives bounds rather than a universal closed hierarchy. The sharper bound depends on the embedding-specific kernel subcode \(K\). It is stated in the source's binary, ternary, and quaternary Euclidean/Hermitian setting.
title: Kernel-sensitive generalized Hamming-weight bounds for shortest LCD embeddings
